title: First arrivals: Total receipt
summary: Keep the first occurrence of each distinct reading, preserving encounter order. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence.
descriptionMd:
The reception stamp should acknowledge each visitor's tag only on its first arrival. Neri is closing the print-room account before the afternoon mail. A single total must replace the pile of working slips.

Keep the first occurrence of each distinct reading, preserving encounter order.

Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement firstArrivalsTotalReceipt(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Set membership. Keep the first occurrence of each distinct reading, preserving encounter order. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with set membership. What state describes the portion you have already processed?
Keep the first occurrence of each distinct reading, preserving encounter order. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [7,-3,0,12]. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 16.
The derived sequence is [4,-2]. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 2.
The derived sequence is []. Return the sum of all values in the derived sequence; return 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 0.

overview: Variation: Set membership. Build the sequence once, then report exactly what the inspection card requests.
